title: Extraction architecture decision & acceptance contract
objective: Formally record the extraction architecture decision based on accumulated Gate 1B evidence (Batches 04, 04B, 04C, 04C-R1, 04C-R2), document rejected alternatives, freeze shared taxonomies, author the Batch 06 validation runbook, and pre-register production certification thresholds.
mustNotChange: deterministic Extraction V1 semantics or frozen-baseline behavior
production extraction authority remains the existing deterministic baseline until Batch 06 production certification
no Batch 06 implementation, provider calls, blind corpus execution, or shadow-mode execution
evaluation, policy, verdict, canonical persistence, dossier, serving, UI, or Batch 01 source/provenance immutability behavior
no prompt, schema, or model changes in production codebase during Batch 05
requiredVerification: formally reconcile and close Batch 04C in docs/transition/GATE_1B_BATCH_04C_CLOSURE.md
record shared reference taxonomies and pre-registered thresholds
update transition control and state manifests
npm run transition:check after acknowledgement and before agent completion
agentCompletionRule: Every committed change touching a non-governance path must be acknowledged by exact commit SHA in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json before the agent may report completion. Uncommitted governed changes fail transition control. Tests are governed changes and require explicit authorization in allowedPathPrefixes. Update RADAR_TRANSITION_CONTROL.md itself only when gate/scope/decision/invariant/exit criteria change.
scopeChangeRule: If implementation requires a path or semantic owner outside this manifest, stop first. Amend the control record/state/batch scope explicitly. Batch 06 is not authorized by this manifest.
